description: A multi-fingered robotic hand capable of complex manipulation and free-base movement, featuring a thumb and four fingers with multiple degrees of freedom.
notes: The robot is configured as a 'hand' but the task registry includes 'inspire_hand_locomotion' with 'freebase' execution, indicating it can move its root body. Manipulation capabilities are evidenced by 'reorient' and 'rotate_z' tasks. End-effector tips are explicitly defined as sites (th_tip, if_tip, mf_tip, rf_tip). Payload capacity is not specified in the manifest.
